asset.description: The asset to transcribe (its whole file)

stream.description: Which audio stream (from the asset's audio_streams). Default 0, the first

language.description: Language code (en, es, he, ...). Default: detect it

diarize.description: Tell speakers apart (S0, S1, ...). Default: true

keywords.description: Names and terms to listen for (nova-3 keyterm prompting)
